description: Only the entries where a service's state changed. Shows when it broke and whether it is flapping.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

hours.description: How many hours back to look.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50, maximum 500.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Required. A name that matches no service is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

name: list_service_state_changes

outputSchema.description: Rows plus enough context to know whether they are all of them.

hint.description: How to narrow the query when truncated.

items.description: The rows, at most `limit` of them.

truncated.description: True if openITCOCKPIT held more rows than were returned.

title: Service State Changes
